none: PAS NCL-3D8115: NCL-3D8115: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead sealing dating to the Roman period. The sealing is approximately rectangular in shape and section. On the obverse is the legend 'LVI' (Legio VI) in relief and on the other, the legend 'VS7' ((...) V(...) S(...) ​centurio) within a rectangular panel.
